All checks pass. Here's a summary of what I built:

**Files created in `evals/qoder_MiniMax-M3_office_prompt_v3/`:**
- `person.js` — Person mesh factory with hip-pivoted legs/arms, walk/sit animation
- `world.js` — 6-floor building, lobby with cafe/lounges/pit/reception, 5 office floors with 4 offices + conf room + lounge each, navigation graphs, call panels, floor indicators
- `elevator_logic.js` — Pure state machine (IDLE→MOVING→DOOR_*) with SCAN scheduling, anti-starvation, capacity gating, dual-environment export
- `elevator.js` — Three.js car, sliding doors, destination buttons, in-car floor indicator, wraps `ElevatorLogic`
- `sim.js` — Simulated clock, day/night keyframes, 20 workers + 80 visitors, plan compilers (arrive/lunch/lounge/meeting/coworker/leave/visitor), weighted activity chooser, action dispatch, collision resolution, HUD with speed/occupancy sliders
- `elevator_logic_test.js` — 9 deterministic Node tests, all passing
- `index.html` — Three.js 0.147.0 + OrbitControls + scripts in mandated order

**Verification:**
- `node elevator_logic_test.js` — 9/9 pass
- `node ../../static_check.js .` — 0 errors, 0 warnings
- `node ../../runtime_check.js evals/qoder_MiniMax-M3_office_prompt_v3` — `ok`, canvas present, 40 animation frames, 3554 scene objects, 0 console/page errors
